item.title: Five Things to Know: Righteous Retribution is the Goal Against Michigan's Stout Defense, Rushing Attack
item.description: Michigan's defense and run game have the Wolverines in College Football Playoff contention as Ohio State seeks righteous retribution in Ann Arbor on Saturday.

item.title: This Week in Our Dumb, Beautiful Sport: Lane Kiffin Drama, College Football Playoff Logjam, and Rivalry Week Chaos Await
item.description: It was a somewhat quiet week in our dumb, beautiful sport, but big rivalry games, a packed CFP field, and Lane Kiffin holding his own school hostage has the CFB chaos meter ready to explode.

item.title: OHSAA Votes to Allow NIL Following Five-Star Ohio State Commit Jamier Brown’s Lawsuit
item.description: Prompted by a lawsuit from five-star Ohio State commit Jamier Brown, the OHSAA has voted to allow high school athletes in Ohio to profit from their name, image and likeness.

item.title: Snap Counts: David Adolph, Bryce West Play Biggest Roles of Career Filling In for Injured Starters vs. Rutgers
item.description: David Adolph and Brandon Inniss played career-high snap counts filling in for Jeremiah Smith and Carnell Tate while Bryce West played a career-high 27 snaps at nickel.

item.title: Sherrone Moore Calls Ohio State “The Best Team in the Country” with “Elite Players Everywhere On the Field,” Wants The Big House to Be “The Loudest Place It’s Ever Been” for The Game
item.description: Wearing his trademark blue-collar jacket, Sherrone Moore called Ohio State “the best team in the country“ with “elite players everywhere on the field” before The Game.

item.title: Ohio State Running Back Bo Jackson Named Big Ten Freshman of the Week
item.description: Ohio State running back Bo Jackson earns Big Ten Freshman of the Week honors following his 110-yard, two-touchdown performance against Rutgers.

item.title: Jake Diebler Feels Buckeyes “Don't Have Bad Days” at Practice, Updates Devin Royal's Progress at Small Forward
item.description: Jake Diebler told the media Monday that the Buckeyes have had "no bad days" in practice this season and that Devin Royal is "doing well" so far in his transition to small forward.

item.title: High Bank Distillery and Eleven Warriors Team Up for “Silver Bullets” Single Barrel, Releasing Black Friday
item.description: Our first barrel pick with High Bank — Silver Bullets — arrives Black Friday at 11 a.m. Limited run, maple syrup cask finish, and proceeds support the Mid-Ohio Food Collective.

item.title: Ryan Day Says Jeremiah Smith, Carnell Tate Are Trending in the Right Direction for Michigan Game: “Nobody Wants to Play More Than Those Two Guys”
item.description: On his weekly Buckeye Roundtable appearance, Ryan Day affirmed that Jeremiah Smith and Carnell Tate are trending in the right direction toward playing vs. Michigan.

item.title: Jeremiah Smith Says He’s “Feeling Good” And “Should Be Good to Go Saturday” Against Michigan
item.description: Jeremiah Smith told the Downs 2 Business podcast that he’s “feeling good” and “should be good to go Saturday” against Michigan after missing the Rutgers game.
